start_here: Say to your AI: "Which of my Stripe accounts should this payment use?" It reads the names of the connections your vault holds and runs tool:find-the-account-of-a-service with {"service": "service_connection:stripe", "held_connections": [...]}, and hands back the one account to use, or names them all when you hold several.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it works from the connection id and the held connection names you hand it, and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect at least one account of the service first (for example Stripe through tool:connect-an-account-by-signing-in-to-the-service).

2. Before starting a tool whose connection is one account of a service, your AI reads the names of the connections your vault holds (each {connection_id, fields}, never a value) and runs tool:find-the-account-of-a-service with {"service": "service_connection:<service>", "held_connections": [...]}.
3. connection_id is the account to name in that tool's input; when it is null and which is given, say which of the listed accounts to use.
4. An id that already names an account (service_connection:<service>:<account>) is answered as given.
